description: This file defines the CampaignTracker class, which manages campaign tracking data within SuiteCRM, extending SugarBean for database operations. It includes properties for campaign tracking fields, methods for saving data with URL scheme validation, and functions to fill in additional details like campaign name and message URL.

classes.name: CampaignTracker
classes.description: A class extending SugarBean to handle campaign tracking data, including properties for campaign info, URL validation, and detail filling methods.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the save method to ensure the tracker URL has a proper scheme before saving.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the tracker name as a summary string for navigation purposes.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional fields like campaign name and message URL based on related data and admin settings.
